page_title: AST 6-1 BHA | Aston Villa v Brighton 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' 6 - 1 The attempt by Ollie Watkins is blocked, but from the edge of the box Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) hits the rebound into the bottom right corner. He alters the score to 6:1.
90+5' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Boubacar Kamara.
90' Simon Adingra (Brighton) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
89' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
87' Substitution. Jack Hinshelwood is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).

85' 5 - 1 Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Ollie Watkins. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the right side of the goal via the woodwork. 5:1!
84' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a yellow card for infringement.
83' The corner from Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is hurriedly cleared.

83' A sweet pass finds Simon Adingra (Brighton) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Emiliano Martinez is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
82' The attendance for today's match is 40636.
79' A yellow card is awarded to Lewis Dunk (Brighton).
79' Unai Emery is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Moussa Diaby suffers an injury and Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) comes on.
77' The game is interrupted now, Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
75' The total number of attempts is 15:7. 6:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
72' Booking. Ansu Fati (Brighton) receives a caution from the referee.

69' Ambitious effort from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
67' Brighton are ruled offside.
65' 4 - 1 Goal! John McGinn passes the ball to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Jason Steele couldn't do anything about it. 4:1.
62' The substitution has been made. Simon Adingra (Brighton) has replaced Solly March.

61' Solly March (Brighton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Ansu Fati (Brighton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
60' A player from Aston Villa takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton have a free kick.
58' Joao Pedro (Brighton) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
57' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
57' Substitution. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) has come on for Nicolo Zaniolo.
56' One of the players from Brighton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jason Steele, who smothers the ball.
55' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
55' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Joao Pedro (Brighton) heads on.
53' No offside! Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Brighton players celebrate.
51' Celebrations by Brighton are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
50' 3 - 1 Goal! Ansu Fati (Brighton) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:1.
48' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
47' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Roberto De Zerbi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pervis Estupinan. He is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
46' Half-time substitution. Evan Ferguson is replaced by Ansu Fati (Brighton).
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Joao Pedro (Brighton) comes on in place of Danny Welbeck.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Joel Veltman (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

45+3' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom left corner. His effort is blocked by Jason Steele with a brilliant diving save!

45+2' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brighton was in an offside position.
42' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to find Danny Welbeck, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
41' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
40' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton. Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends a long ball forward to Matty Cash, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
39' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

38' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity! Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
37' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Aston Villa have a free kick from a promising distance.
35' Good movement by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

32' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
30' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
29' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
28' Solly March (Brighton) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
28' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Andy Madley to decide it wasn’t a foul. The relieved Aston Villa players can finally celebrate.
27' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Aston Villa players aren’t happy.
26' 3 - 0 OWN GOAL! Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 3:0.
24' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Jason Steele pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
23' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Andy Madley to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Aston Villa players can finally celebrate.
23' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Aston Villa players aren’t happy.

21' 2 - 0 GOAL! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 2:0.
18' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.

17' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Andy Madley blows his whistle and it's Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' 1 - 0 What a goal! Matty Cash plays it to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Jason Steele into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
11' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Andy Madley blows the whistle, Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. A free kick to Brighton.
7' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
6' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the left side of the goal that is easily dealt with by Emiliano Martinez.
5' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by John McGinn (Aston Villa).
3' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Brighton will kick the game off.
Andy Madley will referee today's match.
